bio: This inn is everything you could wish for! Your cordial hosts, Ulrike and Manfred Kreger, put their heart and soul into running this popular restaurant. He is the chef and specialises in regional cuisine – one of his specialities is pike-perch from the Rhine, which is practically on the doorstep! Another equally delicious option is the herb-crusted rack of lamb with mint sauce, grilled watermelon and gnocchi. In summer, the tables in the garden to the rear of the building are in high demand. Smart guestrooms available for overnight stays....
